name: app shell (shared entry chunk)
comment: Shared entry chunk loaded on every route — sidebar, topbar, providers. This is the floor every route's first-load JS pays on top of.

name: shell / list views — e.g. /dashboard/[tenantId]
comment: Route class: shell / list views. Ceiling per docs/16-multitenant-performance.md route-class table.

name: heavy data views — e.g. /dashboard/[tenantId]/traces/[traceId]
comment: Route class: heavy data views. Higher ceiling is a deliberate, reviewed allowance for the virtualization library and table chrome — not an escape hatch for unrelated bloat.
